title: Job Openings at M-P Infrastructure Limited
content:
M-P Infrastructure (MPI) is a leading infrastructure development and management company committed to laying the foundation for Africa’s future. For decades, we have delivered world-class infrastructure that powers economies, connects communities, and drives sustainable progress across the continent.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Internal Audit Manager 

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced and strategic Internal Audit Manager to lead its Internal Audit & Control function in Lagos.
	The successful candidate will provide independent assurance on governance, risk management, internal controls, and compliance across the Company’s operations, projects, and support functions.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute risk-based internal audit plans.
	Lead audits across operations, projects, procurement, contracts, assets, and support functions.
	Evaluate internal controls, governance processes, and risk management systems.
	Identify key risks and strengthen risk mitigation and control frameworks.
	Track implementation of audit recommendations and drive continuous improvement.
	Advise Executive Management on governance, risk, compliance, fraud prevention, and operational effectiveness.
	Lead, coach, and develop the Internal Audit team.
	Ensure audit activities incorporate HSE considerations and professional standards.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
	10–15 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit, Internal Controls, Risk Management, Assurance, or Compliance.
	ACA, ACCA, CIA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification.
	Experience leading audits and supervising audit personnel.
	Strong experience in project-based / operational environments; infrastructure, construction, telecoms, or energy experience is preferred.


Desirable:


	Multi-project / multi-site operational experience.
	Internal control framework development / improvement.
	Capital projects, EPC contracts, and procurement-heavy environments.
	Familiarity with ISO standards and enterprise risk frameworks.


Key Competencies:


	Strong leadership & stakeholder management.
	Advanced analytical & critical thinking.
	High integrity & professional judgment.
	Strong communication & report writing.
	Deep understanding of internal controls, governance & risk management.
	Ability to operate effectively in complex project-driven environments.


Salary
Open.

Application Closing Date29th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "INTERNAL AUDIT MANAGER" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

2.) Project Supervisor 

Job Location: Abuja (FCT), Delta, Kano, Lagos, Rivers

Employment Type: Temporary
Contract Type: 6-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Project: CCTV Installation / Lifting Works

Job Summary


	M-P Infrastructure Limited (MPI) is seeking a technically competent and experienced Project Supervisor to oversee the execution and quality control of CCTV installation works across assigned telecom sites.


Key Responsibilities


	Supervise and verify CCTV installation works against approved technical drawings, site survey data and installation standards.
	Inspect camera mounting, alignment, cabling, power connections, grounding, weatherproofing and terminations.
	Verify camera field of view, focus and image quality before site sign-off.
	Conduct QC checks at pre-installation, mid-installation and post-installation stages.
	Conduct QA audits and document defects, deviations and non-conformances.
	Maintain QC/QA logs, punch lists and site close-out reports.
	Provide daily/weekly progress reports, including QC results and outstanding issues.
	Coordinate with vendors, installation teams and regional leads to resolve technical or logistical challenges.
	Maintain photographic and documentary evidence for audit and client submission.
	Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and report hazards, injuries and unsafe conditions promptly.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree (B.Eng) or HND in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Information Technology or a related field.
	2–4 years of experience in field project supervision, preferably with CCTV or electronic security system installations within the Nigerian telecommunications industry.
	Strong knowledge of CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR systems, power systems including grid, generator and solar integrations at cell sites and basic computing/networking.
	Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
	Ability to manage community relations and prevent site disruptions.
	Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel extensively to remote and urban telecom sites.


Application Closing Date: 23rd August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Please ensure your CV clearly demonstrates your relevant CCTV/project supervision experience and your current location.

 

3.) QA / QC Personnel – Telecom Site Build

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Contract
Contract: 1-Year Contract, Subject to Renewal 

Job Summary


	M-P Infrastructure Limited (MPI) is seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented QA / QC Personnel – Telecom Site Build to join our team.


Key Responsibilities


	Ensure all works comply with approved drawings, BOQ, method statements, and client QA/QC standards.
	Conduct quality inspections and support testing and documentation.
	Prepare daily/weekly QA/QC reports and submit to the Project Manager.
	Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and track corrective actions through closure.
	Support snag/punch list activities and as-built documentation for project handover.
	Ensure sites meet installation-readiness and quality sign-off requirements.
	Enforce HSE and quality procedures on site.
	Identify quality risks early and recommend preventive actions.


Requirements


	Possess an HND / B.Eng / B.Sc in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 7 years' QA / QC experience in civil / infrastructure or telecom site build projects.
	HSE Level 1 – 3 certification.
	COREN registration required.
	Knowledge of ISO 9001 is an advantage.
	Strong ability to read drawings, BOQs, and specifications.
	Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word.
	Must be field-ready, physically fit for site work, and possess strong reporting skills.


Key Competencies:


	Strong attention to detail and zero tolerance for rework
	Excellent documentation and reporting skills
	Strong communication and stakeholder management
	Problem-solving ability and commitment to quality standards
	Integrity and accountability.


Application Closing Date: 25th August, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "QA / QC-Telecom Site Build" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Job Openings at Logisoft Solutions
content:
Logisoft Solutions, is a remote HR management service dedicated to building inclusive and engaging work cultures. We believe that great teams are built on collaboration, respect, and empowerment.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Experienced Storekeeper (Male)

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a reliable and organised Store Keeper to manage the receipt, storage, and distribution of goods in the store.
	The ideal candidate will ensure accurate stock records, proper storage of items, and efficient inventory control.


Key Responsibilities


	Receive, inspect, and record incoming goods and materials.
	Organise and store products properly to maintain order and accessibility.
	Monitor stock levels and report low stock to management.
	Maintain accurate inventory records and update stock registers.
	Issue materials or products as requested by authorised personnel.
	Conduct regular stock counts and reconcile discrepancies.
	Ensure the store area is clean, safe, and well-arranged.
	Prepare reports on stock movement and inventory levels.


Requirements


	Possess an SSCE / OND qualification.
	Proven experience as a storekeeper, warehouse assistant, or similar role.
	Good organisational and record-keeping skills.
	Basic knowledge of inventory management.
	Ability to work with minimal supervision.
	Attention to detail and accountability.


Salary
N75,000 - N80,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 14th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the  Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For more enquiries, contact via WhatsApp: 09031641216.
	Must be available to work on weekends


 

2.) Experienced Barista 

Job Locations: Lekki and Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Operations
Reports To: Operations Manager

Summary


	We are currently seeking a smart, customer-friendly, and experienced Barista to join our team in Ikoyi Lagos.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing and serving quality  beverages, delivering excellent customer service, maintaining cleanliness, and supporting the smooth daily operations of the café.


Job Description


	
	The Barista is responsible for preparing and serving high-quality beverages and drinks in a friendly, efficient, and professional manner.
	
	
	They are key to creating a welcoming atmosphere for customers and ensuring exceptional service per the Company standards.
	


Responsibilities
Beverage and Food Preparation:


	Prepare and serve various hot and cold beverages, including coffee, tea, and speciality drinks, according to standardized recipes.
	Ensure all drinks are presented neatly and served fresh.
	Maintain consistency in taste, quality, and presentation of all items served.


Customer Service:


	Greet customers warmly and take their orders with a positive attitude.
	Provide menu suggestions and answer customer questions about ingredients and preparation methods.
	Handle customer complaints or inquiries politely and resolve issues promptly.


Hygiene and Cleanliness:


	Good grooming and professional appearance
	Maintain a clean and organized workstation, including counters, machines, and utensils.
	Follow health and safety guidelines for food handling and preparation.
	Conduct regular cleaning of equipment and the café area to meet hygiene standards.


Inventory and Supplies:


	Monitor stock levels of coffee, milk, syrups, and other supplies.
	Notify management of low stock or equipment maintenance needs.
	Assist in restocking shelves and organizing storage areas.


Team Collaboration:


	Work collaboratively with team members to ensure smooth operations during busy periods.
	Support other team members when needed, including assisting with opening or closing duties.
	Attend team meetings and training sessions to improve skills and knowledge.


Qualifications


	Minimum of an SSCE or equivalent.
	Prior experience as a barista is mandatory.


Skills and Competencies:


	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
	Ability to work quickly and efficiently under pressure.
	Attention to detail and a passion for delivering quality service.
	Knowledge of coffee brewing techniques.
	Previous experience as a Barista or in a similar hospitality/customer service role is an added advantage
	Strong customer service orientation.


Physical Requirements:


	Ability to stand for extended periods.
	Capability to lift and carry items up to 15 kg (e.g., coffee supplies or equipment).
	Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-energy environment.


Work Hours: 

StructuringEmployee Benefits Packages


	
	Flexible shifts, including mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays, as required.
	


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 8th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For more enquiries, contact via WhatsApp: 09031641216.
	Preference will be given to applicants residing in Lekki and Ikoyi.


 

3.) Customer Service Representative (CSR)

Job Location: Lekki/Ikoyi Lagos,
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive, customer-oriented Customer Service Representative (CSR) to join our team.
	The ideal candidate will manage customer inquiries, resolve complaints, process orders, and ensure a smooth customer experience across all communication channels.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond quickly to customer inquiries via phone, email, social media, and live chat.
	Address product or service complaints professionally and efficiently.
	Provide accurate information about products, services, pricing, and policies.
	Process orders, forms, applications, and requests.
	Update and maintain customer records in the system.
	Follow up with customers to ensure satisfaction and resolve issues.
	Escalate complex problems to the appropriate department when needed.
	Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling products and services.
	Achieve individual and team performance targets (response time, resolution time, customer satisfaction ratings).


Requirements & Qualifications


	Minimum of OND / HND / Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field.
	1–2 years of experience in customer service or call centre roles (preferred).
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
	Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities.
	Ability to multitask and manage time effectively.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.
	Positive attitude and excellent interpersonal skills.
	Must be living within Lekki & Ikoyi.
	Must be available to work on weekends


Key Competencies:


	Customer-centric approach
	Emotional intelligence
	Attention to detail
	Teamwork and collaboration
	Adaptability and resilience.


Salary
N130,000 - N150,000 per month.

Application Closing Date: 7th September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail. 

Note: For more enquiries, contact via WhatsApp: 09031641216.

 

4.) Experienced Kitchen Assistant

Job Locations: Lekki / Ikate and Gbagada Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a reliable and hardworking Kitchen Assistant to support daily kitchen operations.
	The ideal candidate will assist in food preparation, maintain cleanliness, and ensure the kitchen runs efficiently while adhering to food safety standards.


Key Responsibilities


	Assist in basic food preparation such as washing, peeling, chopping, and portioning ingredients
	Support chefs and cooks in meal preparation and cooking activities
	Maintain cleanliness of kitchen surfaces, utensils, and equipment
	Wash dishes, pots, and kitchen tools promptly and efficiently
	Ensure proper storage of food items in line with hygiene standards
	Dispose of waste appropriately and maintain a tidy work environment
	Help with receiving and storing deliveries of food supplies
	Follow all health, safety, and hygiene regulations
	Perform any other duties as assigned by the chef or kitchen supervisor


Requirements & Qualifications


	Minimum of SSCE or equivalent
	Previous experience in a kitchen or food service environment is an advantage
	Basic knowledge of food safety and hygiene practices
	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
	Good physical stamina and ability to stand for long periods
	Strong teamwork and communication skills
	Willingness to learn and take instructions


Key Skills :


	Attention to Detail
	Cleanliness & Hygiene Awareness
	Teamwork & Cooperation
	Time Management
	Reliability & Discipline.


Salary
N75,000 - N80,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 28th August, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	For more enquiries, contact via WhatsApp: 09031641216.
	Must be available to work on weekends.
